summary: Recent discussions focus on extending Data Source V2 push‑down to support joins, set operations, and window functions; introducing an OBJECT data type that aligns field names; and exploring CI optimization by skipping redundant runs on master. Parallel efforts include testing an AI bot for pull‑request reviews, planning the first community sync, and proposing security enforcement operators and GROUPS window frames.
